{{Quote|Operation supernova is a go.|Meetra Surik|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Operation supernova''' was [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]]'s term for the skirmish that took place in a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] outside of [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3950 BBY]]. After discovering that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] had been taken [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] by a [[Scourge (Sith)|member]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], Surik traveled to Dromund Kaas to rescue him. Surik then met with a Sith called [[Sechel]], who was also [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]]' [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]. She learned the person she was looking for was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and paid Sechel four thousand [[Imperial credit|credits]] to set up a meeting with the Sith. Sechel told Scourge&mdash;the Sith that captured Revan&mdash;that a woman was looking for him, and Scourge had him set up the meeting and told him to have [[Murtog]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nyriss' security [[Chief/Legends|chief]], and his crew meet him there. Sechel later informed Surik of the Sith's identity, Scourge, and told her to meet him at a cave outside of Kaas City. There, she was ambushed by Murtog and [[Unidentified male soldier (Dromund Kaas)|three]] [[Unidentified female soldier (Sai tok)|other]] [[Unidentified female soldier (Force push)|soldiers]], and was forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] them. Shortly after the skirmish, Lord Scourge agreed to help Surik rescue Revan in exchange for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] helping to [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|assassinate]] the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We'll give them every chance to surrender. But be ready for this to get ugly. Hopefully it won't come to that. Maybe Lord Scourge is curious enough about why I'm here to hear me out before he tries anything.|Meetra Surik to T3-M4|<ref name="Revan" />}}
In [[3950 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]] and [[T3-M4]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] companion, traveled to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], to rescue Revan after discovering he had been taken [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] by a [[Scourge (Sith)|Sith]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nathema]]. Surik arrived at [[Kaas City]]'s [[Dromund Kaas spaceport|spaceport]] and met with a local [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] named [[Larvit]] to exchange some [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]] for information, a meeting with a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] called [[Sechel]]&mdash;who was also [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]]' [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]&mdash;and over twelve thousand [[Imperial credit]]s. Surik later met with Sechel in the [[Nexus Room]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], and she showed him the [[Hologram/Legends|holoimage]] of the Sith that was recorded by T3, who had been present with Revan on Nathema and had recorded Revan's capture. Surik learned the person she was after was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and paid Sechel four thousand credits to set up a meeting between them. Sechel told Scourge&mdash;the Sith that captured Revan on Nathema&mdash;that Surik had a holoimage of him and was looking for him; Scourge ordered Sechel to set up a meeting and to have [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nyriss' security [[Chief/Legends|chief]], [[Murtog]], and his crew meet him there. Sechel later informed Surik of the Sith's identity, Scourge, and instructed her to meet him at a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] outside of Kaas City. She received several [[Force vision/Legends|premonitions]] of a trap before she arrived at the cave.<ref name="Revan" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|Is anyone here? Hello? Is anyone here?''"<br />"''Don't move! We have you surrounded.''"<br />"''Lord Scourge? Is that you? I only want to talk.''"<br />"''Lie flat on the ground and put your hands behind your head. If not, we open fire.''"<br />"''Now, Tee-Three!|Meetra Surik and a soldier|<ref name="Revan" />}}
After arriving at the cave, Surik entered and was ordered to lie down and surrender by one of the four [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], consisting of Murtog, a [[Unidentified male soldier (Dromund Kaas)|male soldier]], and two [[Unidentified female soldier (Sai tok)|female]] [[Unidentified female soldier (Force push)|soldiers]]. She had T3 turn on his headlight to full power, blinding the four soldiers who were wearing [[Night-vision goggles/Legends|night goggles]]. They opened fire on Surik, forcing her to evade; Surik [[Force jump/Legends|jumped]] and used her [[Meetra Surik's second lightsaber|lightsaber]] to [[Shiak|stab]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] a nearby male soldier. She then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force push|hurl]] a female soldier into the far wall, killing her on impact. The other two soldiers ripped the [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] from their heads and opened fire on Surik. While the other male soldier was distracted, T3 used his [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] to set him [[Fire/Legends|ablaze]]. His shrieks distracted the surviving female soldier long enough for Surik to [[Force speed/Legends|charge]] and use her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to [[Sai tok/Legends|cleave]] through the soldier's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and body.<ref name="Revan" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You're a Jedi. What he said was true. He saw you. He knew.''"<br />"''What are you talking about?''"<br />"''You're here because of Revan. You're here to rescue him.''"<br />"''I'm impressed you figured it out so quickly.''"<br />"''I didn't figure it out. Revan told me.|Scourge and Meetra Surik|<ref name="Revan" />}}
After the skirmish Lord Scourge, who had witnessed the whole battle, realized that Surik had come to rescue Revan and revealed to her that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had been taken captive. Following a brief conversation, Scourge agreed to take Surik to Revan and to help rescue him. The Sith Lord also told her of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and of [[Ritual of Nathema|the ritual]] the Emperor performed to gain [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]], and of how the Emperor planned to start another [[Great Galactic War|war]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Scourge agreed to provide proof of his claims when Surik indicated she needed more to go on that just his word.<ref name="Revan" />

Later, Scourge ambushed Sechel in his [[Sechel's secret apartment|secret apartment]]. The Sith Lord then took the files that proved that Nyriss and the other Dark Councilors were [[Nathema conspiracy|conspiring]] against the Emperor and killed Sechel. Scourge returned to the cave, giving the files to Surik and allowing her three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] to look them over. T3 cracked the encryption and verified the data in half the time. Surik then agreed to accept the Sith's help.<ref name="Revan" />

Meanwhile, Scourge secretly enlisted the Emperor's help in rescuing Revan by giving him the files about the conspiracy being carried out by the Dark Council. After being verified, the Emperor [[Purge of the Dark Council|purged]] the Dark Council at the same time Scourge and Surik rescued Revan. After rescuing Revan, Scourge revealed his reason for helping and talked the Jedi into attempting to [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|assassinate]] the Emperor.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Operation supernova first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
